productTitle: American Long-Arm Eye-Care Clamp Desk Lamp (Luxo-style architect lamp)
authoredBy: in-chat scene design — classic articulated swing-arm Luxo-style clamp desk lamp with dome shade; 8 colour variants cycled 1-6 across slots; neutral white 4000K per the clean task-light bulb typical of architect/draftsman lamps

scenes.prompt: An architect's drafting-table corner, shot on a 35mm lens at standing eye-level slight three-quarter so the articulated swing-arm clamp desk lamp anchors the back-right of a 1:1 frame clamped to the edge of a large angled drafting board. Early morning: cool diffuse north-facing light through a tall steel-framed window at frame-left; the only second light source is that window. Style with a half-drawn architectural floor plan in graphite on tracing paper, a triangular set-square and adjustable scale rule, a brass-ferruled drafting pencil resting in the plan, a small jar of bulldog clips, and a folded raw-linen rag. Walls are warm cream limewash with a single leaning Le Corbusier monograph. The lamp matches the reference image exactly — articulated metal swing-arm with two spring-balanced segments in the body colour shown in the reference, dome-shaped painted-metal shade, integrated edge clamp on the desk — switched ON, neutral white 4000K (matches the clean white task-light bulb shown inside the variant reference). Palette of warm cream, graphite, raw linen, brass, body-colour accent. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
accents: floor plan in graphite on tracing paper
